_comment: Type-checks this package's own test/** — the package's main program only includes src/**. Run by the package's 'typecheck' script. The loosened flags live in the shared package-test profile. `paths` is redeclared in full (extends replaces the key rather than merging it) to add the package's own public specifier: test/type-tests/ asserts the published hook/component contract, so it has to import `@codexo/exojs-react` by name, and the mapping resolves that to source so a clean checkout needs no prior build. React itself resolves through this package's own node_modules; the root package carries no react dependency.
